constraints.description: The contract classifies every selected documentation source exactly once and maps every product surface to one planned document ID or explicit exclusion.

validation.validation_method: Isolated source and route fixtures plus current-tree resolved counts

constraints.description: Raw private history, local paths, credentials, private keys, and exact private-source copies are rejected while reviewed provenance remains possible.

validation.validation_method: Sanitizer negative controls and public provenance fixtures

constraints.description: The publication entrypoint preserves child-validator failures and requires exactly one Pages publisher.

validation.validation_method: Child-failure, missing-publisher, competing-publisher, and valid single-publisher controls

constraints.description: The current repository remains an observed failure until planned pages exist and the competing publisher is removed; the foundation makes no portal-readiness claim.

validation.validation_method: Current-tree validator output identifies missing document IDs and two Pages publishers

constraints.description: Strict OpenSpec passes, earlier portal artifacts remain unchanged, and no runtime, React application, provider/model, realtime, vendored, or raw .prometheus content changes.

validation.validation_method: Strict OpenSpec, prior artifact hashes, and scoped git diff

global_rules: Treat the OpenSpec change and KBD phase plan as acceptance authority.
Keep GitHub Actions deployment-only; routine verification remains local.
Do not publish raw .prometheus, KBD event/session payloads, conversations, credentials, or machine-local paths.
Do not claim the final portal builds or deploys from this foundation change.
termination_conditions: All five blocking constraints have observed evidence.
Strict OpenSpec and both refiner schemas pass.
The referenced review artifact exists and the scoped diff contains no prohibited product changes.
